value.name: asks about wife's knowledge
value.description: Miles asks whether Rex's wife knows about or has evidence of his activities.
evidence: And your wife is aware of or has evidence of your activities?

value.name: confirms video evidence
value.description: Rex responds that there is video evidence, implying his infidelity is documented.

value.name: asks about prenuptial agreement
value.description: Miles shifts to the practical divorce issue by asking whether there is a prenuptial agreement.
evidence: And to cut to the chase, forensically speaking -- is there a pre-nup?

value.name: rex hangs his head
value.description: Rex lowers his head, signaling embarrassment or defeat at the question.

value.name: miles sympathizes with rex
value.description: Miles responds with a sympathetic sigh and a moralizing remark about blame and responsibility.
evidence: MILES The fault, dear Brutus, is not in our stars, but in ourselves.

value.name: asks desired settlement terms
value.description: Miles asks Rex what kind of divorce settlement he wants and what terms he considers possible.
evidence: Well, let me ask you this: what kind of settlement do you seek? What are, for you, the parameters of the possible?
